queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE 1=1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE 1=1 AND status = 'pendiente'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity),0) AS cnt FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelado'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM users WHERE role = 'customer'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) AS val FROM orders WHERE 1=1 AND status != 'cancelado'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) AS val FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelado' AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) AS val FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelado' AND YEARWEEK(created_at,1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(),1)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) AS val FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelado' AND YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(created_at) = MONTH(CURDATE())
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) AS val FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelado' AND YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE())
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY status ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day_date, COALESCE(SUM(total),0) AS total_sales FROM orders WHERE 1=1 AND status != 'cancelado' AND source = 'web' GROUP BY day_date ORDER BY day_date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day_date, COALESCE(SUM(total),0) AS total_sales FROM orders WHERE 1=1 AND status != 'cancelado' AND source = 'pos' GROUP BY day_date ORDER BY day_date ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(total),0) AS total_sales FROM orders WHERE 1=1 AND status != 'cancelado' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at,'%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.price - COALESCE(p.cost,0))),0) AS profit FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelado' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.price, p.cost, (SELECT pi.image_path FROM product_images pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.is_main DESC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS image_path, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelado' GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.price, p.cost ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.price, p.cost, (SELECT pi.image_path FROM product_images pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.is_main DESC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS image_path, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelado' GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.price, p.cost ORDER BY total_qty ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.price, p.cost, (SELECT pi.image_path FROM product_images pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.is_main DESC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS image_path, SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.price - COALESCE(p.cost,0))) AS total_profit, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelado' GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.price, p.cost ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM `orders` ORDER BY `created_at` DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT p.id, p.name, (SELECT pi.image_path FROM product_images pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.is_main DESC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS image_path, ROUND(AVG(r.rating),1) AS avg_rating, COUNT(r.id) AS total_ratings FROM ratings r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.status = 'visible' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, total_ratings DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.name, (SELECT pi.image_path FROM product_images pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.is_main DESC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS image_path, ROUND(AVG(r.rating),1) AS avg_rating, COUNT(r.id) AS total_ratings FROM ratings r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.status = 'visible' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY avg_rating ASC, total_ratings DESC LIMIT 1
